caption: the third luxor - customizable gods, catchable upgrades and the longest campaign of the line.
about: Luxor 3 (2007) adds the series' deepest progression: between tracks you buy upgrades, dress your shooter's powers and collect scarabs that unlock the gods' favor. The track design leans on split paths and catch-and-carry upgrades, and the campaign stretches to eighty-eight stages. It is the marble line at its most systematic.
The steam listing still sells the pc build - the third of three luxor chapters with a live official door.
